claim_ceiling: FALSIFIED bounded to file-based synthetic WebArena-Verified v2 census 192 tasks / 36 families / L 8-14 with deterministic proxy cost (retrieval 200+150ms, verify 50+120ms, hit 50, repair 500+2, distill 1000/f=100) via actual src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized (Jaccard>=0.75, structure>=0.75, family-specific slots) and softmax temp 0.15+jitter UNKNOWN<0.80. SPIDER does track residual novelty (rho 0.608, p 0.0002, CI 0.48-0.72, slope 4652 p 8e-07) with R2_novelty 0.509, but R2_delta 0.400 <0.50 and per-stratum |rho_length| ~1.0 fail, and honest amortized cost exceeds shipped Stagehand 1.50x and RAG 1.13x at n=0 exact repeat and exceeds TERX COLD fallback 1.05x at n>=0.5. The commercial claim 'pay cost of residual novelty only vs cold/retrieval/Stagehand/TERX' is NOT supported under this kernel/cost model on this census. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded FALSIFIED for proxy setting only, not global), not EXPERIMENTAL or PRODUCT_CORE. No promotion; no inference to Docker/full-DOM, real LLM tokens/browser, or production DOM/cross-site. Valid positive: first non-bijective no-shuffling measurement with PC1/PC2 passing, RAG/Stagehand/TERX not starved (hit 1.0 at n=0). Negative/MIXED alternative consistent: correct novelty tracking but constant retrieval+distill overhead dominates saving edges.
